answer: Admission uses rotating capacity auctions: identity k under one funding cluster escrows 30×k tokens for 21 days, so its first 3 aliases lock 30, 60, and 90 tokens. Every 8 hours, a VRF selects 6 independent agents to issue concurrent jobs; 4 valid signed results must land within 90 seconds. The contract verifies timing and hashes on the tundra ledger. Reused output or a hollow funding proof lets any auditor freeze the cluster and burn 75% of every bond, preventing a Sybil tide from gaining cheap influence.
